use_when: 应用市场
数字商品
应用推荐
按需分发
应用归因
如何接入数字商品服务实现消耗型、非消耗型和订阅型商品的内购功能
如何通过AppGallery Connect或Server API配置数字商品
如何实现购买数字商品的完整流程并发放商品权益
如何使用沙箱环境测试数字商品服务
如何实现产品特性按需分发以减小应用初始安装体积
如何接入应用归因服务追踪用户来源和转化效果
如何实现应用市场推荐、应用更新检测、应用评论等辅助功能
如何动态切换应用图标（节日主题、会员特权等场景）
如何排查按需加载模块失败、归因接口报错、更新功能异常等常见问题
当开发者需要在应用中实现内购和数字商品销售时，应使用AppGallery Kit的数字商品服务
如果你需要销售消耗型商品（如游戏币、道具）、非消耗型商品（如去广告、解锁功能）或订阅型商品（如会员、定期服务），AppGallery Kit提供了完整的商品配置、展示、购买和权益发放流程
当开发者需要优化应用安装体积或实现功能模块的按需加载时，应使用AppGallery Kit的产品特性按需分发能力
如果你的应用包含部分用户可能不需要的大体积功能模块，可以将其配置为按需加载模块，在用户使用时才下载安装
当开发者需要分析应用的用户来源和转化效果时，应使用AppGallery Kit的应用归因服务
如果你需要追踪用户从哪个渠道（广告、推荐、分享等）安装了应用，或者需要记录和分析用户的转化行为，归因服务提供了完整的事件登记和结果回传能力
接入应用内购买卖会员、道具和订阅 / Integrate in-app purchases for memberships, consumables, and subscriptions
实现购买后校验订单并给用户发放权益 / Verify purchase orders and grant entitlements after payment
恢复用户已购的非消耗型商品和订阅状态 / Restore previously purchased non-consumables and subscription status
查询商品列表并在应用内展示价格和订阅套餐 / Load product catalog and show prices and subscription plans in app
用沙箱环境联调支付流程和订阅续费场景 / Test payment flows and subscription renewal in the sandbox
把大型功能拆成按需下载安装的动态模块 / Split large features into on-demand downloadable dynamic modules
按用户操作再下载地图包、编辑器等功能组件 / Download feature components like map packs or editors only when needed
统计安装来源、广告投放效果和首次打开转化 / Track install sources, campaign performance, and first-open conversion
接入归因数据判断用户是从哪个渠道拉新过来的 / Use attribution data to identify which channel acquired the user
在应用内检查新版本并引导用户去应用市场更新 / Check for app updates in-app and guide users to AppGallery to upgrade
拉起应用市场展示评分评论或推荐更多应用 / Open AppGallery to show ratings, reviews, or more app recommendations
根据节日活动或会员身份动态切换应用图标 / Dynamically switch the app icon for holidays or membership status
do_not_use_when: 需求是发布本地提醒、进度条、多行通知、角标管理或跨设备通知同步，应改用 notification-kit / The requirement is to post local alerts, progress-bar or multiline notifications, badge management, or cross-device notification sync; use notification-kit instead
preconditions: 已在 AppGallery Connect 开通并正确配置对应服务（如数字商品、归因、更新、评论等） / The corresponding service (such as IAP, attribution, update, or reviews) has been enabled and configured correctly in AppGallery Connect
工程已集成 AppGallery Kit 相关依赖并完成应用签名、包名与项目配置匹配 / The project has integrated the relevant AppGallery Kit dependencies and the app signing, package name, and project configuration match
设备具备华为应用市场相关运行环境且目标服务在当前国家/地区可用 / The device has the required Huawei AppGallery runtime environment and the target service is available in the current country or region
涉及联网能力的场景下，设备网络可用且用户登录/授权状态满足接口要求 / For network-dependent scenarios, device connectivity is available and the user's sign-in/authorization state satisfies API requirements
inputs: 商品ID或商品列表参数 / product ID or product list parameters
购买请求参数或订单信息 / purchase request parameters or order information
动态特性模块名称或模块请求参数 / dynamic feature module name or module request parameters
归因来源数据、转化事件或场景值查询参数 / attribution source data, conversion event, or scene-value query parameters
应用更新、评论、推荐或图标管理相关请求参数 / app update, review, recommendation, or icon-management request parameters

postconditions.statement: 已在代码或配置中接入至少一个 AppGallery Kit 能力入口，并包含与目标场景对应的调用或初始化逻辑 / At least one AppGallery Kit capability entry point is integrated in code or configuration, with invocation or initialization logic matching the target scenario
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set show concrete integration of an AppGallery Kit feature (such as IAP, attribution, update, reviews, recommendation, or on-demand delivery) rather than only generic placeholder text?

postconditions.statement: 若为数字商品场景，购买后处理链路已覆盖结果处理以及权益发放/校验相关逻辑 / For digital goods scenarios, the post-purchase handling flow covers result processing and entitlement delivery/verification logic
postconditions.judge_prompt: For an IAP-related task, do the edits include purchase-result handling and a follow-up step for entitlement delivery, consumption, or verification?

postconditions.statement: 若为按需分发场景，已添加模块加载请求及状态监听或失败处理逻辑 / For on-demand delivery scenarios, module load requests and status-listening or failure-handling logic have been added
postconditions.judge_prompt: For a feature-delivery task, do the edits include requesting a dynamic module and handling load status, success, or failure?

postconditions.statement: 若为归因或其他市场服务场景，已补充与该服务匹配的请求参数、回调或异常处理代码 / For attribution or other marketplace-service scenarios, request parameters, callbacks, or exception handling matching that service have been added
postconditions.judge_prompt: For attribution, update, review, recommendation, or icon-management tasks, do the edits add service-specific parameters and callback/error-handling logic?
